pet-cremation-singapore.title: Private Pet Cremation Singapore | Enshrine Pet Afterlife
pet-cremation-singapore.description: Single private pet cremation in Singapore. Includes pick-up, floral arrangement, complimentary urn & certificate. Witness the process and bid farewell with dignity.
pet-cremation-singapore.heroImageAlt: Private cremation farewell hall at Enshrine
pet-cremation-singapore.intro: Saying goodbye to a beloved companion is never easy. Enshrine provides single, private pet cremation in Singapore — your pet is cremated alone, never alongside others, so the ashes you receive are truly and only theirs. From gentle pick-up to a dignified farewell, we hold the space for your family to grieve and remember.

blocks.heading: What is single (private) pet cremation?
blocks.body:
In a single private cremation, your pet is the only one in the chamber. This is different from communal or partitioned cremation, where several pets are cremated together and individual ashes cannot be guaranteed. Choosing a private cremation means the cremated remains returned to you belong to your pet alone — an assurance that matters deeply to most families.

You are welcome to be present throughout. Many families find that witnessing the process, and having the chance to say a final goodbye in person, brings a real sense of closure.

blocks.heading: What's included
list: Respectful pick-up of your pet from your home or the vet
A floral arrangement and a quiet farewell space
The private cremation itself, witnessed if you wish
Optional bone picking, should you wish to personally inter your pet

blocks.heading: How the farewell unfolds
blocks.body:
Once your pet is in our care, we arrange a time that suits your family. On the day, you are received in a calm, private farewell hall where you can spend unhurried final moments together. After the ceremony, the cremation is carried out and the ashes are carefully collected, placed in your complimentary urn, and returned to you with the certificate.

Our advisors guide you at every step and explain your options clearly — there is no pressure, only support.

blocks.heading: After the cremation
blocks.body: Many families choose to keep their pet close in a personalised keepsake, give them a permanent resting place at our freehold pet columbarium, or return their ashes to nature through a private sea scattering. A celebrant-led or religious farewell can also be arranged. Whatever feels right for your family, we will help you plan it.

faqs.q: Will I receive only my pet’s ashes?
faqs.a: Yes. Because the cremation is single and private, your pet is the only one in the chamber, so the ashes returned to you are theirs alone.

faqs.q: Can I be present during the cremation?
faqs.a: Yes. You are welcome to witness the process and bid farewell in person. Many families find this brings comfort and closure.

faqs.q: Do you collect my pet from my home or the vet?
faqs.a: Yes, we arrange respectful pick-up from your home or your veterinary clinic at a time that suits you.

faqs.q: What do I receive afterwards?
faqs.a: A complimentary urn containing your pet’s ashes and an official cremation certificate. Optional bone picking is available if you wish to inter your pet personally.

faqs.q: What can I do with the ashes?
faqs.a: You may keep them in a keepsake, place them in our freehold columbarium, or scatter them at sea. Our advisors will talk you through every option.

pet-cremation-singapore.ctaTitle: Speak with a pet farewell advisor
pet-cremation-singapore.ctaText: We are here whenever you are ready. Reach us for private pet cremation enquiries in Singapore.

pet-columbarium-singapore.title: Pet Columbarium Singapore – First Freehold Niches | Enshrine
pet-columbarium-singapore.description: Singapore's first & only freehold pet columbarium at 74 Lorong 6 Geylang — 10,000+ air-conditioned niches with CCTV. Single & family pet niches, visiting by appointment.
pet-columbarium-singapore.heroImageAlt: Enshrine pet columbarium building at 74 Lorong 6 Geylang
pet-columbarium-singapore.intro: Enshrine is home to Singapore's first and only freehold pet columbarium, at 74 Lorong 6 Geylang — a quiet, dignified place to remember the pets who have crossed the rainbow bridge.

blocks.heading: A permanent resting place
blocks.body: Enshrine’s newly built pet columbarium is a freehold, four-storey building at 74 Lorong 6 Geylang, with more than 10,000 pet niches. The interiors are fully air-conditioned for a quiet, comfortable and elegant atmosphere, and the entire building is monitored by CCTV. Every level has a pets’ play area, so you are welcome to bring your living companions when you come to remember the one who has crossed the rainbow bridge.

blocks.heading: Why freehold matters
blocks.body: Most columbaria in Singapore are leasehold, which means the resting place is secured only for a fixed term. Enshrine is the first and only freehold pet columbarium in Singapore: your pet’s niche is theirs for the long term, with no lease to renew and no relocation to worry about later. For many families, that permanence is exactly the peace of mind they are looking for.

blocks.heading: Single and family pet niches
list: Single niches hold one pet, with a transparent cover so you can see the urn directly during visits
Family niches accommodate up to 32 pets together with no divider, so companions stay side by side
Every bamboo urn is customised with your pet’s photo, name and dates; family niches carry a personalised plaque

blocks.heading: A calm, unhurried visit
blocks.body: Visiting is by appointment for niche owners, which keeps the space peaceful for everyone. Come spend a quiet moment, tend to your pet’s niche, and let your living pets stretch their legs in the play area. Our advisors are on hand to help you choose the right niche and arrange a viewing.

blocks.heading: Keepsakes and personalisation
blocks.body: Beyond the niche itself, many families choose a personalised keepsake to keep their pet close at home — a customised urn or a memento crafted with care. Within the columbarium, single niches feature a transparent cover so you can see your pet’s bamboo urn directly, each one inscribed with their photo, name and dates, while family niches carry a personalised plaque. These small, deliberate touches turn a resting place into a true memorial — somewhere that feels personal every time you visit.

pet-columbarium-singapore.ctaTitle: Arrange a visit to the columbarium
pet-columbarium-singapore.ctaText: Visiting is by appointment. Speak with an advisor to view our single and family pet niches.

faqs.q: Where is the columbarium?
faqs.a: At 74 Lorong 6 Geylang, Singapore — a freehold, four-storey, fully air-conditioned building.

faqs.q: What does “freehold” mean for me?
faqs.a: Your pet’s niche is secured for the long term, with no fixed lease to renew and no future relocation — unlike most leasehold columbaria.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a single and family niche?
faqs.a: A single niche holds one pet behind a transparent cover; a family niche holds up to 32 pets together with no divider, with a personalised plaque.

faqs.q: Can I visit, and can I bring my other pets?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting is by appointment, and every level has a pets’ play area, so your living companions are welcome.

pet-sea-scattering-singapore.title: Pet Sea Scattering Singapore | Enshrine Pet Afterlife
pet-sea-scattering-singapore.description: Private pet sea scattering in Singapore with an optional Buddhist, Taoist, Christian or Catholic ritual. A chartered boat and advisors to guide you through.
pet-sea-scattering-singapore.heroImageAlt: Private sea scattering of pet cremains
pet-sea-scattering-singapore.intro: Return your beloved pet’s ashes to nature with a private sea scattering — a serene, personal farewell on the open water, with an optional religious ritual.

blocks.heading: A private farewell at sea
blocks.body: A sea scattering returns your beloved pet’s ashes to nature in a serene, personal way. We charter a boat solely for your family, so the occasion is unhurried and entirely yours — no sharing the moment with strangers. Our advisors accompany you throughout, handling the arrangements so you can simply be present and say goodbye.

blocks.heading: An optional religious ritual
blocks.body: If you wish, we arrange for the appropriate religious leader to conduct a Buddhist, Taoist, Christian or Catholic ritual on board during the scattering. The rite is carried out with care and reverence, in keeping with your family’s faith.

blocks.heading: What to expect on the day
blocks.body: We meet you at the jetty and sail out to the designated waters. When you are ready, the ashes are scattered together with flowers, and you are given the time and space for a few words or a quiet moment. The boat then returns gently to shore. The whole experience is calm, dignified and led at your pace.

blocks.heading: Bringing the farewell together
blocks.body: A sea scattering can follow a private cremation and be paired with a celebrant or religious ceremony for a complete farewell. Speak with our advisors and we will help you plan each part around your family.

blocks.heading: Why families choose a sea scattering
blocks.body: For some, a sea scattering reflects a love of the outdoors, the freedom of open water, or simply a wish to let go in a way that feels natural and unconfined. There is no niche to visit, but many families find comfort in returning to the coast on anniversaries, watching the same horizon their pet was released into. It can stand on its own or complete a fuller farewell, and because the boat is yours alone, the moment unfolds entirely on your terms — quiet, personal and unhurried.

blocks.heading: We take care of the details
blocks.body: Chartering the boat, timing the tides, coordinating any religious leader, preparing the flowers — we handle the logistics so nothing distracts you from the farewell. Just tell us what you have in mind, and your advisor will arrange the rest.

pet-sea-scattering-singapore.ctaText: Talk to an advisor about chartering a boat and arranging an optional religious ritual.

faqs.q: Is the boat shared with other families?
faqs.a: No. We charter the boat solely for your family, so the farewell is private and unhurried.

faqs.q: Can we include a religious ritual?
faqs.a: Yes — we can arrange a Buddhist, Taoist, Christian or Catholic leader to conduct the rite on board.

faqs.q: How long does it take?
faqs.a: It varies with the weather and waters, but the experience is led at your pace. Our advisors will share timings when you plan the date.

faqs.q: Can we combine it with cremation or a ceremony?
faqs.a: Absolutely. A sea scattering often follows a private cremation and can be paired with a celebrant or religious farewell.

pet-celebrant-religious-services.title: Pet Celebrant & Religious Funeral Services | Enshrine SG
pet-celebrant-religious-services.description: Pet celebrant and religious funeral services in Singapore — Buddhist, Taoist, Christian & Catholic rites, a prayer & eulogy session, and a video tribute montage.
pet-celebrant-religious-services.heroImageAlt: Pet celebrant service with floral tribute
pet-celebrant-religious-services.intro: Honour the bond you shared with a celebrant-led or religious farewell, conducted with the rites and reverence of your faith.

blocks.heading: A ceremony that honours your bond
blocks.body: Our celebrant service is a 30-minute prayer and eulogy session, built around three gentle moments — a Final Touch, a Tribute, and a Final Farewell. It is a chance to put words to the love you shared and to say goodbye in a way that feels meaningful, whether your family is religious or not.

blocks.heading: Rites across four faiths
blocks.body: We offer religious funeral services across four faiths — Buddhist, Taoist, Christian and Catholic — each conducted with the appropriate rites and reverence. We coordinate with the right religious leader so the ceremony observes the customs that matter to your family.

blocks.heading: A video tribute montage
blocks.body: To remember the day, we can prepare a video montage capturing your pet’s precious moments. It plays during the ceremony and stays with you afterwards as a lasting keepsake of a life well loved.

blocks.heading: We plan it with you
blocks.body: From scheduling to the religious leader to the order of the ceremony, our advisors handle the details and guide you at every step. A celebrant or religious farewell pairs naturally with a private cremation, a columbarium niche or a sea scattering.

blocks.heading: For families of any faith — or none
blocks.body: Not every farewell is religious, and that is perfectly alright. Our celebrant ceremony works beautifully on its own, centred on memory and gratitude rather than ritual. If your family does observe a faith, we weave in the appropriate customs so the service feels true to your beliefs. Either way, the focus stays where it belongs: on the companion you are honouring.

blocks.heading: Part of a complete farewell
blocks.body: A celebrant or religious ceremony sits naturally alongside the rest of our care. Many families pair it with a private cremation on the same day, then choose a columbarium niche or a sea scattering to follow. Your advisor will help you shape an order of events that feels unhurried and right for your family.

pet-celebrant-religious-services.ctaTitle: Arrange a celebrant or religious farewell
pet-celebrant-religious-services.ctaText: Speak with an advisor about a celebrant-led ceremony or a Buddhist, Taoist, Christian or Catholic rite.

faqs.q: Which faiths do you cater to?
faqs.a: Buddhist, Taoist, Christian and Catholic rites, each conducted with the appropriate customs. A non-religious celebrant ceremony is also available.

faqs.q: How long is the ceremony?
faqs.a: The celebrant session runs about 30 minutes — a Final Touch, a Tribute and a Final Farewell.

faqs.q: Can I get a video tribute?
faqs.a: Yes. We can prepare a video montage of your pet’s moments to play at the ceremony and keep afterwards.

faqs.q: Can the ceremony be non-religious?
faqs.a: Yes. Our celebrant ceremony stands on its own, centred on memory and gratitude, with no religious elements unless you want them.

faqs.q: Where does the ceremony take place?
faqs.a: At our Geylang premises, as part of the farewell. Speak with an advisor to plan the timing and order of events.

pricing.title: Pet Cremation & Columbarium Pricing | Enshrine Singapore
pricing.description: Transparent pricing for pet cremation, columbarium niches and memorial services in Singapore. Speak with an Enshrine advisor for a tailored quote.
pricing.heroImageAlt: Columbarium niche wall with feature lighting
pricing.intro: Every family’s needs are different, so we tailor our packages to you. Speak with an advisor for a clear, itemised quote with no hidden costs.

blocks.heading: What shapes your package
blocks.body: Your package depends on the services you choose, so we tailor it to your family rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all bundle.
list: Private pet cremation, with pick-up, a complimentary urn and certificate
Celebrant-led and religious ceremonies (Buddhist, Taoist, Christian, Catholic)
Customised urns, plaques and memorial keepsakes

blocks.heading: Transparent and itemised
blocks.body: We believe a farewell should never come with surprises. Every quote is itemised so you can see exactly what is included, and there are no hidden costs. If you only need certain services, you only pay for those.

blocks.heading: Tailored to your family
blocks.body: Some families want a simple private cremation; others want a full ceremony, a columbarium niche and a sea scattering. We will talk through your wishes and your budget and recommend an option that feels right, with no pressure.

blocks.heading: How to get a quote
blocks.body: The quickest way is to speak with an advisor by phone or WhatsApp. Tell us what you have in mind and we will prepare a clear, written quote — usually the same day. You can also visit our columbarium by appointment to see the niches in person.

blocks.heading: What a private cremation typically includes
blocks.body: As a guide, a private pet cremation with Enshrine generally covers respectful pick-up, a floral arrangement and farewell space, the single cremation itself (which you may witness), and a complimentary urn with an official certificate. From there, families add what matters to them — a ceremony, a niche, a sea scattering or keepsakes. Your advisor will itemise each element clearly so the total reflects only what you have chosen.

blocks.heading: Planning ahead
blocks.body: Some families prefer to understand their options before the time comes, so the decisions are easier later. We are glad to talk through choices and costs with no obligation — a quiet conversation now can lift a great deal of pressure during a difficult moment.

pricing.ctaText: Tell us what you need and we will prepare a transparent, itemised quote for your family.

faqs.q: Do you have fixed packages or custom quotes?
faqs.a: Both — we can suggest a suitable package or build a custom quote around exactly the services you need.

faqs.q: Are there any hidden costs?
faqs.a: No. Every quote is itemised and transparent, so you know what is included before you decide.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Call or WhatsApp our advisors at +65 9009 9234, or email enquiries@enshrinepet.com.sg, and we will prepare one — usually the same day.

faqs.q: Can I plan in advance?
faqs.a: Yes. Many families prefer to understand their options ahead of time. We are happy to discuss choices and costs with no obligation.
